global: This shio ramen boasts a clear, light broth with delicate noodles, topped with chashu pork, nori, and menma. Served in a blue-patterned bowl with chopsticks and spoon, it rests on a pink surface under soft, even lighting.

regions.background: Pink table surface has smooth texture, uniform color, and subtle gradient shading with faint light reflection.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior, blue floral patterned rim, and smooth glossy surface.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is pale yellow, clear, and glossy, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface, slightly curved bowl, and tapered handle.
regions.chopsticks: Light wooden chopsticks, smooth and slender, rest diagonally with subtle grain patterns visible on their surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with uneven edges and visible white specks on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and soft, slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with segmented, curved shapes and visible fibrous texture.
